T: Sacramento has the best almonds. Don't argue.
D: A headstrong senior at a Catholic school in Sacramento butts heads with her mum over her plans for college.
P: Serve the mains when Lady Bird sits down to Thanksgiving at Danny's grandmother's house.
S: the big Thanksgiving at Danny's family home
Baguette slices toasted with olive oil, spread with goat's cheese, topped with roasted pumpkin, sage and a drizzle of honey.
Lady Bird and Julie eating the unblessed wafers like chips

Rice paper rounds fried for seconds until they puff into crisp white wafers, dusted with salt and chilli and served with a sweet chilli lime dip. Cut 10 rice paper sheets into quarters or rounds with scissors. Heat 3cm oil in a wok to 180C. Drop pieces in one at a time; they puff in 2 seconds, so lift out straight away and drain on paper. Dust with fine salt and a pinch of chilli powder. Mix 100ml sweet chilli sauce with the juice of a lime for the dip.

Almonds roasted with olive oil, rosemary and smoked salt at 180C for 10 minutes, served warm with marinated olives. Toss 300g almonds with olive oil, chopped rosemary and smoked salt. Spread on a tray and roast at 180C for 10 minutes until fragrant. Serve warm in a bowl beside green olives, a taste of the valley the film keeps leaving and coming home to.
M: the big Thanksgiving at Danny's family home

Brined turkey breast roasted with thyme butter until juicy, with sage and onion stuffing, buttery mash, green beans and pan gravy. Brine a 1.5kg turkey breast overnight in 2L water with 100g salt and 50g sugar. Pat dry, rub with 40g butter and thyme and roast at 180C to 70C inside, about 75 minutes, then rest. Mix 200g torn bread with a fried onion, chopped sage, an egg and 150ml stock and bake 30 minutes. Mash 1kg boiled potatoes with butter and milk. Steam 300g beans. Make gravy from the pan juices.
Marion working double shifts at the hospital
Chicken, broccoli and rice baked in a creamy cheese sauce at 180C for 40 minutes, the kind of dinner that waits in the oven for whoever gets home.
W: Fudgy chocolate brownies baked at 170C for 25 minutes, cooled, cut into squares and wrapped in paper for the stall. Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk in 250g sugar and 3 eggs, then fold in 100g flour and 2 tbsp cocoa. Bake in a lined tin at 170C for 25 minutes. Cool completely, cut into squares and wrap each in paper for the stall.
K: Café shift brown sugar cinnamon latte
Lady Bird's job at the coffee shop

Espresso stirred with brown sugar and cinnamon syrup, topped with silky steamed milk and a dusting of cinnamon, served in glasses. Simmer 60g brown sugar, 60ml water and a cinnamon stick for 3 minutes, then cool. Brew 4 espresso shots, or 250ml very strong coffee. Put 1 tbsp of the syrup in each of four glasses and add the coffee. Heat 600ml milk until steaming and froth it with a whisk or frother. Pour slowly over the coffee, holding back the foam, then spoon foam on top and dust with cinnamon.
